stories.title: Alistan EU y México reunión sobre drones en la frontera

en.title: US and Mexico prepare meeting on drones at the border
en.summary: The United States and Mexico are organizing a meeting to discuss drone-related issues at their shared border.

stories.title: México y EU evaluarán operativo para combatir drones en frontera norte

en.title: Mexico and US will evaluate operation to combat drones on northern border
en.summary: Mexico and the US will assess the "Águila Alta" operation next week, designed to counter drones at the northern border. According to Mexico's Defense Secretary, the operation has not yet produced results and no increase in criminal drone use has been detected.

stories.title: Investigan en Brasil a Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: Investigation opened into Flávio Bolsonaro in Brazil
en.summary: Brazil's Federal Police are investigating senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro for alleged money laundering and corruption linked to connections with former banker Daniel Vorcaro. Bolsonaro, second in voting polls for October 4 elections, acknowledged requesting 24 million dollars from Vorcaro.

stories.title: Explosión en local de comida deja una persona muerta y 11 heridas

en.title: Explosion in food establishment leaves one dead and 11 injured
en.summary: An explosion at a commercial establishment in Mexico City's Álvaro Obregón borough killed one person and injured eleven others, prompting emergency response teams to the scene.

stories.title: Cruz Azul será local, pero el Azteca es la casa del América: Zendejas

en.title: Cruz Azul will be home team, but the Azteca is América's house: Zendejas
en.summary: América player Alejandro Zendejas conveyed that despite Cruz Azul being the designated home team for Saturday's match, the Azteca Stadium belongs to the Eagles. Cruz Azul remains the only Liga MX club without its own stadium despite being owned by a cement company.

stories.title: Zverev y Shelton llegan a la final del Abierto de EU

en.title: Zverev and Shelton reach US Open final
en.summary: German Alexander Zverev defeated Russian Karen Khachanov to advance to the US Open final, where he will face American Ben Shelton, who beat fellow American Frances Tiafoe in a match lasting three hours and 20 minutes.

stories.title: Ignora Kast aniversario del golpe de Estado en Chile y a sus víctimas

en.title: Kast ignores anniversary of Chile's coup and its victims
en.summary: Chile's far-right president José Antonio Kast did not commemorate the 53rd anniversary of the 1973 coup that brought General Augusto Pinochet to power, marking the first time since democracy's return with no official ceremony. Families of the disappeared, universities, and left-leaning groups held their own memorial events.

stories.title: Explosión de tanque de gas deja saldo de al menos un muerto y 11 heridos en la alcaldía Álvaro Obregón

en.title: Gas tank explosion leaves at least one dead and 11 wounded in Álvaro Obregón borough
en.summary: An explosion at a gas tank in Mexico City's Álvaro Obregón borough resulted in at least one fatality and 11 injuries. Firefighters and civil protection officials cordoned off a five-block area while conducting emergency operations.

stories.title: Lady Gaga se convierte en madre: da la bienvenida a su primer hijo con Michael Polansky

en.title: Lady Gaga becomes a mother: welcomes her first child with Michael Polansky
en.summary: Lady Gaga, the 40-year-old singer born Stefani Germanotta, has welcomed her first child with Michael Polansky, whom she began dating in 2020 and became engaged to in 2024.

stories.title: Lady Gaga ya es mamá; recibe a su primer hijo junto a Michael Polansky

en.title: Lady Gaga is now a mother; welcomes her first child with Michael Polansky
en.summary: Lady Gaga has given birth to her first child with Michael Polansky.

stories.title: Explosión por acumulación de gas provoca derrumbe y deja una persona muerta en alcaldía Álvaro Obregón; hay varios lesionados

en.title: Gas accumulation explosion causes building collapse and kills one person in Álvaro Obregón municipality; several injured
en.summary: A gas explosion near Avenida Alta Tensión and Calle Santa Lucía in the Minas de Cristo neighborhood caused a building to collapse, resulting in one death and multiple injuries.

stories.title: Lady Gaga se convierte en mamá junto a Michael Polansky

en.title: Lady Gaga Becomes a Mother with Michael Polansky
en.summary: Lady Gaga and Michael Polansky welcomed their first child, though details about the baby's name, sex, and birth date remain undisclosed.

stories.title: Porsche deja ir a Bugatti y destina parte de la venta a pagar pensiones

en.title: Porsche divests from Bugatti and allocates sale proceeds toward pension payments
en.summary: Porsche sold Bugatti as part of a strategic shift aimed at improving profitability and cash flow in a more demanding market, with some proceeds directed to pension obligations.

stories.title: ¿Cómo se tramita la pensión por invalidez del ISSSTE? Estos son los pasos a seguir

en.title: How to process an ISSSTE disability pension? These are the steps to follow
en.summary: The ISSSTE offers a disability pension option available to insured members, with specific procedural steps required for application and approval.

stories.title: Hacienda le baja los impuestos a gasolinas; diésel tendrá cero IEPS

en.title: Treasury Lowers Gasoline Taxes; Diesel Will Have Zero IEPS
en.summary: From September 12-18, gasoline and diesel will receive the year's largest tax reductions on special production and services taxes, with diesel reaching zero IEPS.

stories.title: Pemex pierde 1,756 millones de pesos al mes por contención de precios de gasolina y diésel

en.title: Pemex loses 1,756 million pesos monthly from gasoline and diesel price controls
en.summary: Mexico's state oil company lost 10,541 million pesos between March and August due to fuel price discounts at its terminals.

stories.title: Pova 8 Pro 5G: el diseño estilo Matrix que querías por menos de 7,000 pesos

en.title: Pova 8 Pro 5G: Matrix-style design for under 7,000 pesos
en.summary: The Pova 8 Pro mid-range smartphone features a 50 MP camera, 6,500 mAh battery, 256 GB storage, and customizable rear lights.
